# Terre des Hommes Deutschland e.V.

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-30 · status **complete**

Terre des Hommes Deutschland e.V. (Osnabrück) is a member of the Terre des Hommes International Federation (TDHIF) and a foreign donor NGO, not an Indian company under Section 135. It runs a South Asia regional programme from a Pune office covering India, Afghanistan, Nepal, Pakistan and Tajikistan, funding around 100 partner NGOs region-wide via long-term partnerships rather than open calls. India-only spend is not disclosed separately from the South Asia region total (EUR 7.75m in 2021, EUR 7.95m in 2023); India had 78 projects in 2021 and 66 in 2023 spanning child labour, education, health, migration, protection and gender-equality themes, with confirmed footprints in Jharkhand (Koderma), Bihar and Manipur. Named Indian partner NGOs identified include New Vision, Centre for Youth Development and Activities, Savera, Samarpan, Ekjut, Vikas Samvad, YUVA, AMAN, NFBM Jagriti School for Blind Girls, Chaupal Grameen Vikas Prashikshan Evam Samiti, People's Cultural Centre, MGVS, Life Education and Development Support, Centre for Women and Girls, and Lake Gardens Women and Children Development Centre. No open RFP, application portal or disclosed grant-size range was found; care was taken to keep this record separate from the similarly-named but distinct Terre des Hommes Suisse/Foundation (Lausanne), which also runs an India programme via tdh-india.org.

Website: https://www.tdh.de

- Evidence for every fact with source URL
